name: ICRISAT District Level Database (DLD)
publisher: International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics & ICAR
citation: ICRISAT (2020). Meso-level District-Level Database for Indian Agriculture (1966-2017). ICRISAT, Patancheru, India.
geographicScope: Pan-India: 580+ districts spanning 20 major agricultural states
limitations: Historical time series standardized to 1966 district boundaries; recent bifurcated districts mapped to parent administrative units.

name: Agricultural Statistics at a Glance
publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
citation: DES, MoAFW (2023). Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2022-23. Government of India, New Delhi.
geographicScope: All Indian States and Union Territories
limitations: State-level aggregates published annually; district final estimates subject to state crop cutting experiment (CCE) reconciliation.

name: IMD High-Resolution Daily & Seasonal Meteorological Dataset
publisher: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences, GoI
citation: Pai et al. (2014). Development of a new high spatial resolution (0.25° × 0.25°) daily gridded rainfall data set over India (1901–2010). Mausam, 65(1), 1-18.
license: Non-commercial Academic Research & Public Good Advisory Policy
limitations: Spatial interpolation over complex terrain may introduce minor smoothing in hilly districts.

name: eNAM & Agmarknet Daily Agricultural Wholesale Mandi Prices
publisher: Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (DMI), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
citation: Agmarknet Portal (2024). Agricultural Marketing Information System. Ministry of Agriculture, GoI.
geographicScope: 2,700+ regulated APMC Mandis across 28 States and 4 UTs
limitations: Prices reflect arrivals at APMC mandis; local village farmgate prices may have minor transportation discounts.

name: ICAR Package of Practices & Crop Production Guidelines
publisher: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), New Delhi
citation: ICAR (2021). Handbook of Agriculture: Facts and Figures for Farmers, Students and All Interested in Farming. ICAR, New Delhi.
limitations: Agronomic thresholds represent optimal and tolerable physiological limits under recommended field management.

name: National Soil Health Card Database
publisher: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture, GoI
citation: Soil Health Card Portal (2023). District-wise Soil Fertility Status of India. MoAFW, New Delhi.
limitations: Sampled at grid intervals (2.5 ha irrigated, 10 ha rainfed); represents district modal fertility ratings.
